entries.title: Hosea 10:1
segments:
Empty; many interpreters prefer to render "luxuriant," and this agrees best with what follows. 
 
  The altars; erected to false gods. 
 
It is commonly the case, that in proportion as God multiplies his outward gifts to men, they multiply their rebellions against him.  This is a most painful evidence of the deceitfulness and desperate wickedness of the human heart.

entries.title: Hosea 10:2
segments: They whose heart is not steadfast in God's service will be reckoned among his enemies, and perish with them.

entries.title: Hosea 10:3
segments:
Now they shall say; be forced by their calamities to say. 
 
When men cast off the fear of God, no earthly resources can avail to make them prosperous and happy.

entries.title: Hosea 10:4
segments: Judgment--hemlock; justice in the observance of covenants and the administration of law is perverted, and thus turned into a poisonous weed.  Compare

. 
 
vv 4-11. 
 
When integrity and truth in the observance of compacts have perished from a community, and the seat of justice is made the instrument of violence and oppression, the measure of its iniquity is full, and God's desolating judgments will speedily fall upon it, as upon Israel of old.

entries.title: Hosea 10:5
segments: The calves of Beth-aven; literally, "the heifers of Beth-aven," a contemptuous expression for the gods of Jeroboam, of which that at Beth-aven was a specimen.  Beth-aven is Beth-el. See note

entries.title: Hosea 10:6
segments:
It shall be--carried; the golden calf of Beth-el. 
 
  Jareb; see note on

entries.title: Hosea 10:7
segments: Her king; this seems to be a prophecy of the captivity of Hoshea, and the extinction in him of the kingdom of Israel.

entries.title: Hosea 10:8
segments:
Aven; Beth-aven, that is, Beth-el. 
 
  Cover us--Fall on us; shelter us from the vengeance of God.  The people say this when pressed by their enemies, with no means of escape. Compare
.  The most terrible application of these words will be at the final judgment.

entries.title: Hosea 10:9
segments: From the days of Gibeah; see

. 
 
  There they stood; the Benjamites stood determined to defend the children of iniquity, and so Ephraim now persists in sin.
Did not; or, "shall not;" it shall be one of a more destructive character.  From that battle a remnant escaped who perpetuated the tribe,
; but Israel shall be utterly taken away.

entries.title: Hosea 10:10
segments: When they shall bind--two furrows; the "two transgressions" are the two calves in Beth-el and Dan.

entries.title: Hosea 10:11
segments: Loveth to tread; because then she can have abundance of food.

Passed over upon her fair neck; put a yoke upon it, that she might be subjected to harder services. 
 
  Make Ephraim to ride; the meaning seems to be, "I will yoke Ephraim," namely, to a plough or harrow; that is, put him to hard service.

entries.title: Hosea 10:12
segments:
Sow to yourselves; if the people would escape the punishment threatened in the preceding verse, let them of their own accord sow righteousness, that they may reap mercy. 
 
  Break up your fallow ground; the same as, "make you a new heart and a new spirit,"
.  Compare

. 
 
It is vain to hope for any permanent reformation which does not begin with thorough humiliation of the heart before God, such as shall prepare it to receive with meekness the seed of divine truth.

entries.title: Hosea 10:13
segments:
vv 13-15. 
 
"Whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap," is a principle of God's government which holds good alike of communities and of individuals.  When the seed is iniquity, the harvest must be wrath; nor can the power and wealth of any people exempt it from this righteous rule of retribution.

entries.title: Hosea 10:14
segments: Shalman; Shalmaneser.

entries.title: Hosea 10:15
segments: In a morning; speedily.
